messages:
kate-w: Heads up — just saw a sharp spike in cross-region egress from EU tier customers routing to APAC variants. Console shows repeated 5xxs and a lot of fallback swaps :eyes: https://console.redwood/internal/dash/variant-oscillations
jason-m: seeing it too. telemetry shows tenant 438 re-evaluating routes every ~6s: r-v1 -> r-v2 -> r-v1 -> r-v2 (repeat). pref-cache miss rate huge. logs: `route_eval tenant=438 from=eu->apac variant_swap=4 attempts=12`
priya-s: likely symptom of the new route-precedence change we rolled in the canary yesterday. if affinity TTL is low, the router keeps flipping when a variant briefly fails and then comes back.
andrew-k: that canary adjusted priority-weights and introduced `prefer_aux_region: true` for eu-tier. i can revert but want a minimal mitigation first — circuit breaker or cooldown on variant swap?
emma-d: agree minimal first. enable cooldown on swap + increase affinity_ttl for affected tenants. 30s cooldown would stop the thrash. also add quick alert for 'variant_oscillation_rate' > 5/min.
lina: long term we need sticky-variant per-tenant with a quarantine for variants that fail transiently. propose `affinity_ttl=300s` + `variant_quarantine=60s` for now. also make sure quota gating doesn't trigger immediate ejection.
infra-bot: autoscaler: burst pool spun up at 2026-03-20T14:05:20Z for region apac-north. pref-cache_miss=78%, open_connections spike=420.
jason-m: quick config I'd push:
```
router:
  smart_routing:
    affinity_ttl_seconds: 300
    swap_cooldown_seconds: 30
    variant_quarantine_seconds: 60
    max_swap_per_minute: 2
```
jason-m: i'll patch canary to those values and flip on the cooldown in the controller.
andrew-k: if you do that, also reduce `prefer_aux_region` on the weight table to avoid immediate egress when primary is dippier. set weight eu-primary=0.85 -> 0.95 and aux=0.15 -> 0.05 for the canary.
priya-s: note: we should avoid blanket affinity for enterprise tenants that expect geo-failover. add tenant-level override.
jason-m: ack. patching now. i'll target canary fleet -> small subset of eu-tier tenants first.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started by jason-m for router-config v2026.03.20-hotfix -> 10% canary
kate-w: thanks. i'll mute the noisy alert and set a one-off dashboard tile for variant swaps by tenant so SRE can watch.
infra-bot: metric delta after canary (2m): variant_swap_rate -78%, pref-cache_miss -42%, p50 latency eu->apac back to baseline.
deploy-bot: canary success. promoted to 100% at 2026-03-20T14:09:48Z
emma-d: follow-up actions: 1) retro tomorrow, 2) add alert for 'variant_oscillation_rate', 3) document tenant override in runbook. I'll create the ticket. :memo: 
lina: i'll draft the API change for tenant-level affinity overrides and a config page in Console to surface affinity TTL per route.
andrew-k: quick note — we should add a guard in the router to refuse immediate two-way swaps within X seconds (detect flip-flop). i'll open a PR after retro.
kate-w: great work. one more ask — add a telemetry tag when fallback is triggered due to quota vs connectivity so we can separate causes in alerts.
jason-m: done. added `fallback_reason` tags to logs and metrics.
kate-w: closing loop: i've filed ENG-4822 (retro + dashboard + alert) and assigned owners. thanks all. :tada:
